cc:Work.dc:description: Volume scales linearly with regulated 10 kN duration, under fixed initial 30 MPa absolute/300 K and 3 MPa ideal-regulator cutoff. Adiabatic model requires 75.63 L per second; isothermal 60.30 L per second requires continuous heat input. These are alternative idealized thermal boundary conditions, not bounds for real compressed air. Tank hardware and exterior volume excluded.
